request.subject: PORTRAIT:UNDEAD:PATROL_BOAT

layers.text: Turn it into a spooky ghost ship: the hull becomes near-black charcoal wood, colour #2a2a30, with a pale ivory bone rail and a small skull on the bow; the red sail becomes tattered dark charcoal grey cloth, colour #5a5660, with torn zigzag edges; the pennant becomes a torn black rag; one small lantern glows bright violet. Keep the boat shape, mast, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
